method: Actual model visual inspection using view_image of indexed contact sheets; individual/full-size follow-up for English crop defects and please mismatch. Every catalog image was displayed and reviewed. Checksums bind observations to bytes, not perceptual approval.
scope: Visual semantic review only. Audio listening remains pending. Existing published files were not edited by this audit.

statusDefinitions.pass: Visible concept representative for target lexical sense.
statusDefinitions.context-required: Representative only with stated sense/context; not approved as an unambiguous standalone cue.
statusDefinitions.reject: Visible mismatch, material crop defect, or inadequate semantic cue; do not reuse in new content before correction and reinspection.
